keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Marlon Gomes (Shakhtar Donetsk).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Shakhtar Donetsk 0, Fenerbahce 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Milan Skriniar (Fenerbahce).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Alisson Santana (Shakhtar Donetsk).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
İsmail Yüksek (Fenerbahce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Shakhtar Donetsk. Isaque replaces Marlon Gomes.
Goal! Shakhtar Donetsk 0, Fenerbahce 1. Vedat Muriqi (Fenerbahce) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Valerii Bondar (Shakhtar Donetsk) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Irfan Can Kahveci replaces Kerem Aktürkoglu.
Pedro Henrique (Shakhtar Donetsk) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Mattéo Guendouzi replaces Mason Greenwood.
Substitution, Shakhtar Donetsk. Irakli Azarovi replaces Vinícius Tobias.
Substitution, Shakhtar Donetsk. Luca Meirelles replaces Lassina Traoré.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Romelu Lukaku replaces Vedat Muriqi.
Substitution, Shakhtar Donetsk. Prosper Obah replaces Yehor Nazaryna.
